title: Retail-controller readback preflight (SDL/XID path)
purpose: Record what a downstream title-facing controller API sees on real Xbox after chainload. This is the Tier-2 preflight for retail-game input injection: it exercises the Xbox USB/XID controller route through nxdk SDL rather than the oracle agent's shared synthetic buffer.

real-xbox/physical/preflight.notes: Default mode records the physical controller state if present. A future kernel/XID hook can run this same XBE with explicit expected fields.

preconditions: for physical preflight, a controller is connected before chainload
